reasons: CS4239 is offered only in Sem 1. The only remaining non-exchange Sem 1 is semester 5, but its prerequisite CS3235 (and CS2105/CS2107) cannot be completed before then.
CS3219 is fixed in semester 5, and semester 7 is an exchange semester with no modules.
Therefore no valid plan can include all must-take courses CS3282, CS2105, CS4239 and CS3219.
